screening.samplingFinding: Eighty unseen final-cohort query pages were collected headlessly across eight previously qualified domains and all target dimensions. Forty-eight passed strict machine gates, forty-seven passed visual capture-structure review, and a balanced forty-one-page subset was selected to reach the 300-page final-cohort target without avoidable retailer concentration.
screening.visualValidationFinding: All forty-eight machine-pass pages were inspected in original-resolution site montages, with an individual original-resolution check for the sparse Fabric Bistro layout. Forty-seven contain at least eight independent query-relevant product roots with visible title and price evidence. The bakery-packaging page was rejected for category drift; ambiguous or absent package quantities remain valid abstention cases.
